# casdoor_enforcer (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor enforcer, a Casbin enforcer built from a model and an adapter.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_enforcer" "api" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "api"
  display_name = "API enforcer"
  model        = "${casdoor_model.rbac.owner}/${casdoor_model.rbac.name}"
  adapter      = "${casdoor_adapter.policies.owner}/${casdoor_adapter.policies.name}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the enforcer, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `adapter` (String) The adapter, in the `organization/adapter` format.
- `description` (String) The description.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `model` (String) The model, in the `organization/model` format.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the enforcer was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the enforcer in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_enforcer.example <organization>/<name>
```
